text: Yes, the tree cover on this asset has remained unchanged since 2020. The evidence shows no detected tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. The asset had 43.3 hectares of forest cover in 2020 (11.55% of the total area), and no significant changes were observed through 2025. However, small-scale changes (under 0.5 ha) or those narrower than the 30-meter pixel resolution might not be captured. The data is based on validated sources like Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020, with full spatial coverage of the asset.
